scope: Developer-only strict checker and schema for artifact-bound original/target recorded observations. Native capture harnesses remain the next separate headless implementation.
authorization: Headless code/build/tests only; no Minecraft client/server, screen automation, original class execution, new mod acquisition or publication.

publicArtifact.implementationChanges: None in product/runtime/engine classes, mapping data, adapter catalog or conversion rules. Public archive audit now explicitly refuses the development corpus package.

apiAudit.method: Read-only ZIP text inspection and SHA-256 of the two pinned local mapped-official source archives; no class definition or source redistribution.
reviewed: Authored recipe and non-replacing iron-ingot tag

finalTargetedSyntheticTests.boundary: Synthetic JSON/logs and inert fake JAR bytes in temporary test directories, including a real local hard-link alias. No native behavior or mod executed.

realArtifactIndexCheck.boundary: Actual authored original, retained candidate, proof, receipt and current public JAR hashes and selected static declarations only. Runs are explicitly null.

rootBuild.skipBoundary: Four pre-existing tests are conditional on native symlink creation privileges/support. They were skipped, not passed. The new real hard-link alias test passed; all 77 new checker tests ran.
rootBuild.contract: PASS: 23 prompts, 79 cuts, cursor LB-08/COMPOSE-01; path/structure check only
rootBuild.publicArchive: PASS: final SHA-256 unchanged, 526 ZIP entries, no corpus/CompositionQa/fixtures entries; existing package audit passed
rootBuild.apiBaselinesAndCliSmoke: PASS: existing finite Forge API anchor checks, installed CLI smoke and engine boundary
rootBuild.headlessScriptSuites: PASS: existing networking diagnostics/installation/handshake and public server preflight tests, no game launch

limitations: Recorded matching values are not proof of game execution; independently reviewed native runs remain mandatory.
Native composition capture probes, isolated tick driver and run/exit/shutdown collector are not implemented by this cut.
Checker verifies selected proof declarations and hashes, not ASM/linkage again or authenticity of logs/records.
Recipe XP metadata is not native XP payout validation; bounded 120-tick samples do not prove general anti-duplication behavior.
A quiescent trusted local tree is required; hash rereads are not a filesystem snapshot or hostile-writer sandbox.
No new public profile, adapter, installer admission, UI support or compatibility expansion.
No new real-mod intake, redistribution of private inputs or publication.

next.headless: Implement and compile separate pinned source/target probes producing this schema, actual loaded artifact binding, no-overwrite observation writes and isolated tick/shutdown/failure collection. Do not launch games.
next.nativeGate: Original/target behavior comparison remains required and not authorized; do not accept COMPOSE-01 or unlock LINKAGE-GENERAL.
